name: ollama_list_models
description: List all locally installed Ollama models with size, family, parameter count, and quantization level.

name: ollama_pull_model
description: Download and install an Ollama model from the registry (e.g. 'llama3.2:3b', 'qwen2.5-coder:7b', 'mistral:7b').

model.description: Model name and tag e.g. llama3.2:3b or qwen2.5-coder:7b

name: ollama_push_model
description: Push a local Ollama model to the Ollama model registry.

name: ollama_delete_model
description: Delete a locally installed Ollama model to free up disk space.

name: ollama_copy_model
description: Copy an Ollama model to a new name or alias without re-downloading.

name: ollama_show_model
description: Show detailed information about an installed model — Modelfile, parameters, template, context window size, and architecture details.

name: ollama_create_model
description: Create a custom Ollama model from a Modelfile string — useful for setting system prompts, parameters, or building on top of a base model.

path.description: Path to a Modelfile on disk (alternative to modelfile)

name: ollama_list_running
description: List models currently loaded in VRAM (actively running). Shows size in VRAM and expiry time.

name: ollama_check_health
description: Full health check — tests Ollama connectivity, returns version, installed model count, and currently running models. Use this first if Ollama seems unreachable.

name: ollama_generate
description: Generate text from a local Ollama model. Single-turn completion — provide prompt and optional system instruction. Defaults to OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL env var or qwen2.5-coder:7b.

system_instruction.description: System prompt to set the model's role and behavior

num_predict.description: Max tokens to generate (-1 for unlimited)

name: ollama_chat
description: Multi-turn chat completion with a local Ollama model. Supports full conversation history with user/assistant/system message roles.

system_instruction.description: System message prepended if not already in messages

name: ollama_embed
description: Generate vector embeddings using a local Ollama model — ideal for RAG pipelines without OpenAI API costs. Supports single text or batch arrays.

input.description: Text string or array of strings to embed

name: ollama_code_complete
description: SUPER TOOL: Code generation and completion tuned for coding tasks — uses qwen2.5-coder defaults, returns only code. Good for autocomplete, refactoring, and boilerplate generation.

code.description: Existing code to complete or improve

instruction.description: What to do with the code, or a description of code to generate

name: ollama_extract_json
description: SUPER TOOL: Prompt a local Ollama model and automatically parse the response as JSON. Uses format:json enforcement and retries on parse failure. Perfect for structured data extraction.

prompt.description: What data to extract or generate as JSON

schema_hint.description: Describe the expected JSON structure to guide the model

name: ollama_agent_task
description: SUPER TOOL: Execute an agentic task with a defined role, task description, and optional context. Designed for use in multi-agent pipelines as a low-cost local reasoning step.

task.description: The task for the agent to complete

role.description: Agent role e.g. 'a senior TypeScript developer' or 'a database architect'

context.description: Relevant context, code, or data the agent needs

output_format.description: Describe the desired output format e.g. 'a JSON array' or 'a numbered list'
